macros.name: versolayout
macros.doc: By default, verso paragraphs are set ragged-left; with the declarations in \versolayout setting the paragraph parameters.

macros.name: versoleftmargin
macros.doc: The dimensions \versoleftmargin and \versotextwidth specify the position of the text block on the verso page.

macros.name: versonote
macros.doc: If, in the run of text, you include a call to the macro \versonote{This is a remark}, then that text will be placed on the opposite (ie, ‘verso’) page, lined up with the macro call.

macros.name: versotextwidth
macros.doc: The dimensions \versoleftmargin and \versotextwidth specify the position of the text block on the verso page.
